# ai-watch

PC helper (user 2026-10-29): watches Codex, Gemini and Claude logs for a usage limit, resumes the worker 1 minute after the reset, and on a weekly or far-away limit hands the open handoff/tasks to the next AI until they say done (tools/ai_watch.py, tools/limitwatch). Nothing else needs it.
